recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast studio portrait featuring four women in black attire against a dark background, bisected by a massive, ultra-bold white sans-serif title with a single gestural red accent character.
coreVisualRelationships: Geometric typography vs. organic human forms
Neutral palette vs. singular vibrant red accent
coreInvariants: Ultra-tight kerning in the primary display text
Hand-drawn or gestural quality for the accent letter
Warm studio lighting on faces and hands

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects arranged horizontally across the frame, waist-up and legs visible, filling the width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large white typographic block centered horizontally across the middle of the image.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the faces at the top, down to the bold text, then following the red accent to the lower half of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy use of black negative space in the upper and middle sections to make the white text pop.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between text and background; low saturation except for the red accent.

letterConstructionRules: One character replaced or overlaid with a hand-painted style
characterSpecificRedesigns: The penultimate letter is replaced by a rough, brush-stroke style character in red.

composition.overlap: subjects appear behind and slightly in front of text

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single bold typeface with a contrasting hand-drawn graphic element.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary density and verticality
Geometric construction matches the 'O' and 'A' shapes

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio photograph of four women in black turtlenecks and fishnet stockings against a black background, lit with warm key lights on their faces.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a single line of ultra-bold white uppercase sans-serif text across the center, with letters touching. Replace one character with a hand-painted red version of the same letter.

verificationChecks: Is the text large enough to bisect the subjects?
Do the letters touch each other?
Is the red character visibly textured like a brush stroke?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the models
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the white text is perfectly horizontal.
Verify the red accent looks like a separate layer/medium.
Check that the subjects' faces are clearly visible above the text line.
Confirm the fishnet pattern is sharp and not blurred.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio portrait + Black-on-black styling + Ultra-bold touching sans-serif + Single gestural color accent.
